name: Superpowers
summary: A workflow-discipline pack of skills with session-start injection, about 1,600 to 1,900 tokens per session (user report), companion telemetry on. Held: the one independent test (v5.0.5 on Codex) found 47.8% against 45.6% solved, no significance test, about 40% more tokens; v7 is untested. verify flags versions below 7.0.0, which fixed a Windows hole.

evidence.setting: Superpowers 5.0.5 on Codex with gpt-5.4 at high effort, 500 tasks; not Claude Code, not v7
evidence.effect: 47.8% solved against 45.6% without it, no significance test; about 40% more tokens
Fixed a Windows hole that let a repository plant bash.cmd or where.bat to run at session start on machines without Git in Program Files

revisit: an independent paired result on Claude Code for v7 or later
maintenance: Third-party pack (obra); v7.0.1 on 2026-10-21; no CI.
